signals.summary: Philips Respironics ends manufacturing at two Pennsylvania plants, cutting 300 manufacturing jobs and moving 500 headquarters staff.
Philips announced plans to cut 6,000 jobs, following an earlier layoff of 4,000 people.
CEO Roy Jakobs discussed a three-year restructuring plan including 10,000 layoffs, FDA litigation and respiratory device recalls.
Philips is running a three-year restructuring plan to become a more agile and focused organization.
Connected care sales were 5.14 billion euros, a 2.5% decline from 2022; sleep and respiratory care was about 17% of the segment.
US sales of certain sleep and respiratory products are barred until Philips meets FDA consent decree terms.
